pick.name: Claude Code VS Code extension
pick.what: Native panel, inline diffs, plan review
pick.why: Shares settings/plugins with CLI; VS Code >=1.94
pick.free_limits: Requires a Claude plan (Pro/Max plans/Team/Enterprise) or API billing; counts against plan usage

best_free.name: Zed + Claude Agent (ACP)
best_free.what: Claude Code inside Zed via ACP
best_free.free_limits: Zed charges nothing for external agents; Claude Agent still needs a Claude plan or API key (/login in the agent thread)
best_free.install: Install Zed (brew install --cask zed | winget install ZedIndustries.Zed | curl -f https://zed.dev/install.sh | sh), then zed: acp registry > Claude Agent
best_free.license: Multi-licence repo: editor GPL-3.0, server AGPL-3.0, GPUI Apache-2.0 (GitHub reports NOASSERTION; verify LICENSE files)

alts.name: JetBrains plugin (Claude Code [Beta])
alts.what: Official plugin for IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand and more
alts.why: Official integration with diff viewing and diagnostics
alts.free_limits: Plugin free; needs a Claude plan or Console account

alts.name: Terminal + /ide connection
